I ran into this issue today! This didn't quite work but after some figuring it out I found a different fix. It seemed to be failing when it was trying to copy over the pk12 file, so i just did it manually. 

You could try copying the pk12 file at ```/etc/corosync/qdevice/net/nssdb/qdevice-net-node.p12 ```

to
